assertion_analysis.would_fail_if: include_iron added a nonzero column while the frame's Ic is zero, or the frame's rows changed the subspace reassembly, so the zero-magnetisation solve no longer equals the air-core solve bit for bit.

the frame's Br/Bz contribution diverged from bound.field at the four targets through a wrong current ordering, target block offset or source reduction factor; a wrong operand shared by both sides stays green.
the frame's Psi contribution diverged from bound.psi through the same wiring defects; a wrong psi_matrix shared by both sides stays green.
the solved state contributed nothing above 1e-6 of the air field, i.e. the frame silently did not carry the iron.
the same three properties failed after the coilset was stored and reloaded, which is the reload defect the node repaired at nova/frame/iron.py:38-46.
persist_coil_field reported the wrong reuse flag or reloaded stored values that differed from the values it returned on the first call.
any of the three refusals stopped raising, raised a different class, or changed the message the test matches.
the writer stored the wrong mesh digest, coil key or quadrature for the response it wrote.
the stored response failed to round-trip through npz; both sides call the same monkeypatched field_at, so a wrong field model cannot redden it.

the GPFS state receipt recorded a coil_response_relative above 1e-12, an external_relative_frobenius above 1e-12, a missing refusal message, or a non-positive slice wall; it skips when the receipt is absent.
the production mesher's cell count at 0.08 m changed from 1694 or its ordered vertex geometry changed; merged from the sibling census node, not this node's change.

failure_derivation: baseline arm job 1324861 at 9b016126111a5acaebca064c07432042b5a2628c: 93 passed in 8543.15s (/work/projects/imas_gpu/sophelio/evidence/iron-core-magnetisation/arms/baseline_arm.log); after arm job 1324862 at 1d739e7ec2c85bb661e93afbca84bc9f94b743f5: 95 passed in 9104.13s (same directory, after_arm.log); the 2-test growth is the two tests the node added and neither arm reports a failure.

findings.text: blocking: Aphi is formed as psi/(2*pi*R) with no guard at R = 0, while nova/biot/polysection.py:283-289 and nova/biot/circle.py:363-372 divide with where=radius != 0 and answer 0 on the axis; a grid solve whose target set reaches R = 0 therefore carries inf/nan Aphi once an iron frame is in the source, so the "every grid and point solve carries the iron" claim fails on exactly the axisymmetric grid path.

blocking: frame_versus_direct_probe and frame_versus_direct_loop compare contribution_probe and contribution_loop (lines 73-74, each a call to bound.field/bound.psi) with the same call at lines 112 and 115, so the receipt's 0.0 cannot fail whatever the code does, and the evidence fragment cites that 0.0 at lines 77-78 as a measured agreement at all 110 probes and all 17 loops.

non-blocking: _ring_moments, _affine_sheet_field, _affine_sheet_flux and BoundCurrents.field_matrix/psi_matrix (lines 424-517 and 1071-1104) are a second implementation of the affine-M field evaluation owned by nova/biot/tiledassembly.py:2248 linear_cell_interaction, which the node leaves untouched, so the package keeps two evaluators that the evidence fragment itself calls the reference implementation.

non-blocking: persist_coil_field repeats the digest-keyed persisted-response mechanism already owned by nova/biot/magnetisation.py:300-335 (save/load_magnetisation_interaction refuse a mismatched mesh digest), giving the repository a second cache with its own file format, digest key and refusal messages.

non-blocking: the manual pop of aloc, saloc and aloc_hash from every holder found in vars(coilset) duplicates nova/frame/framesetloc.py:187-209, which already clears exactly those three when the subframe index version moves, and misses any locator reached through a nested attribute, leaving a second invalidation rule beside the owner's.

non-blocking: the persisted-versus-direct assertion compares the stored response against measure.field_at, the same monkeypatched evaluator that filled the store, so it can only catch a store/load transcription error; the plan's 1e-12 contract on the real coil evaluation is asserted only at lines 107-128, which skip when the GPFS receipt is absent.

non-blocking: the after arm runs in this checkout with no header line naming the revision or command it ran at, so the head arm's revision is attested only by arms/commands.json and not by the log the manifest cites.

non-blocking: the row records 2.28e-17 T as "6.2e-12 of the contribution" against its own 1e-12 relative bound, so the two cells cannot describe the same run and a reader cannot tell which figure the test measured.

non-blocking: the census paragraph names a landed CENSUS_CELLS = 1694 constant the test does not carry (tests/test_imas_iron_read.py:170-174 asserts len(actual) == len(expected) == 1694 inline plus an ordered-vertex digest), and that pin is the sibling node's merge rather than this node's change.

non-blocking: the fragment states the full tests/test_magnetisation.py "was not run to completion in this allocation; it is not claimed as a green suite arm here", which contradicts the manifest's recorded green arms (93 passed at the base and 95 passed at the head, jobs 1324861 and 1324862).

non-blocking: the manifest carries no landing: line and no figures: line, so promotion lands no prose record on the plan section and the committed figure at docs/figures/west-stray-field/west-62751-iron-stray-field.png is recorded only under artifacts.

non-blocking: the committed figure sits outside the declared figure path docs/figures/iron-core-magnetisation/icm-iron-field-source; the plan's done_when names docs/figures/west-stray-field/, so the plan and the section's write paths disagree rather than the node drifting.
